# CHP Steam Turbine (CHP_SteamTurbine)

> **Class**: `CHP_SteamTurbine` | **Module**: `energysim.models.thermal` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Combined Heat and Power (CHP) extraction steam turbine, simple correlation.

This is a correlation, not a thermodynamic turbine model: base electrical
power is taken as 1 MW per kg/s of live steam (capped at ``p_max_mw``),
delivered heat is limited to twice the base power, and extraction reduces
electrical output by ``beta`` MW per MW of heat extracted
(``P = P_base - beta * Q``). No pressure levels, enthalpy drop, condensing
tail or part-load efficiency are modelled.

Validity: steam flow 0-``p_max_mw`` kg/s, heat demand <= 2 x base power.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'CHP_Turbine'` | - | Unique component name identifier |
| `p_max_mw` | `float` | `50.0` | MW | - |
| `power_loss_coefficient_beta` | `float` | `0.18` | - | - |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

| Variable | Unit | Description |

## Outputs

## Validity and notes

*No validity range is documented for this model yet.*

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import CHP_SteamTurbine

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('chp_steamturbine', model=CHP_SteamTurbine(), outputs=['P_actual', 'Q_heat_delivered_MW'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['chp_steamturbine'].tail(2))
```
